cutoff.basis: last complete month = the month before the terminal month, whose transaction count is a measured fraction of the trailing-12-month median, not an assumed calendar fact

definition: Descriptive re-cut of the legacy period windows on the current dataset: transaction counts, sample composition, and nominal and CPI-deflated median prices per (property type, window), plus a per-planning-area-year baseline with a stated sample floor. No premium model, no clustering and no trajectory classification is reproduced; window medians are not mix-adjusted and period-over-period changes are not causal claims.

consumerCode.quote: mrt_stations=raw_mrt_stations if not raw_mrt_stations.empty else None,

verification.conclusion: the shipped dist_to_nearest_mrt column reproduces exactly from the sha-pinned bronze station frame and does not reproduce from the 2019 seed; the seed-vs-bronze discrepancy is therefore meaningful and resolves in favour of the bronze frame
verification.method: nearest-station distance recomputed as the minimum haversine_metres over every station in the candidate frame — the same nearest-station distance utils/proximity.py computes via its BallTree(metric='haversine') k=1 selection

legacyClaims.basis: windowCoverage: HDB covers 2017-01 to the measured cutoff; condo source coverage starts 2021-01, so the condo side of the period 2017-2020 is source-missing in this checkout
legacyClaims.claim: Data Period: 2017-2026 (10 years of transaction data)

legacyClaims.basis: featureVintages: no source carries station opening dates, and the only dated station snapshot is the single 2019-12-09 legacy seed (mrtStationsGeojson.updateStampNormalisedDate) — one vintage, nothing per window — and no dated school series exists, so a period-correct distance-to-MRT feature cannot be constructed; the condo side also has no pre-COVID transactions in this checkout
legacyClaims.claim: MRT premiums declined during COVID for both HDB and condo segments, with only partial post-COVID recovery

legacyClaims.basis: featureVintages: school tiers, weights and directory are a single current snapshot with no historical vintage, so premium stability across periods is not measurable
legacyClaims.claim: School proximity premiums remained stable through COVID

legacyClaims.basis: the retired clustering model is not reproduced; planningAreaBaseline provides the descriptive per-area-year medians only
legacyClaims.claim: K-means clustering of area-level appreciation time series identifies 5 distinct temporal patterns, with most areas in moderate growth clusters

legacyClaims.basis: cluster membership and cluster means come from the retired model; the descriptive distribution of area-year median-price change is measured instead (planningAreaBaseline.changeOverall)
legacyClaims.claim: High Growth 31-51% / Moderate Growth 9-17% / ~10% / ~14% / Low Growth 7-18% (cluster table)

legacyClaims.basis: planningAreaBaseline.changeOverall.shareWithin7to17Pct: the share of computed area-year median-price changes inside 7-17%, on this pack's floor; not comparable to the legacy model's appreciation figures
legacyClaims.claim: Most areas cluster in the 7-17% YoY range during strong years

legacyClaims.basis: trajectory classification is a model output of the retired analysis; per-area medians are measured (planningAreaBaseline.perAreaYear) but no trajectory is classified; whether each named example area even appears in the study window is measured in planningAreaBaseline.exampleAreasPresent
legacyClaims.claim: Accelerating: Jurong East, Punggol, Bidadari / Steady: Bishan, Ang Mo Kio, Queenstown / Decelerating: Some mature CCR areas / Volatile: Luxury segments

legacyClaims.basis: causal claim; no identification strategy is reproduced. The condo pre-COVID window is absent from this checkout, so the comparison has no like-for-like baseline
legacyClaims.claim: Recovery asymmetry: HDB recovered faster post-COVID than luxury condos, likely due to demand inelasticity

legacyClaims.basis: this pack's descriptive floor is planningAreaBaseline.floor = 30 transactions in both years; the legacy regression floors are not reproduced
legacyClaims.claim: minimum 300 transactions for HDB areas and 100 for condo areas (regression floor)

2026.note2026PartialYear: 2026 covers 2026-01 → the measured cutoff only (a terminal partial year at this cutoff) and is excluded from year-over-year change

changeOverall.bandNote: the descriptive share of computed area-year median-price changes inside the legacy text's quoted 7-17% band; a median-price change is not the legacy model's year-over-year appreciation figure and this share does not reproduce or validate clustering

planningAreaBaseline.cutoffUpperBoundMeaning: every area-year aggregate ends at the last complete month; the terminal partial month is excluded from all counts and medians
planningAreaBaseline.floorMeaning: a year-over-year change is computed only when BOTH years have at least 30 transactions in that planning area; this pack's floor is a descriptive-display rule, not the legacy regression minimum (300 HDB / 100 condo), which is not reproduced

scope: RS03 temporal-evolution evidence: comparable period windows, sample composition, feature vintages, descriptive price baselines
